instagram.caption:
The brush nobody wants to touch.
The Toilet Area in the Guest Bathroom. It has to be clean and stocked in a way that is obvious to someone who will never ask you where anything is.

What done looks like:
1. One spare roll standing in plain sight on the tank or in a holder a seated person can reach without standing up. A brush that is dry
2. Resting in a holder with no liquid pooled in the bottom. A small trash can with a liner actually in it. No ring at the water line
3. Dust-free floor behind the pedestal

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success toilet area.
